d:
Shahi shadiyon ke lie log aksar rajasthan ke rajvaron aur jaypur ke mahlon ka rukh karte hain, lekin mokama ke 'chhote sarkar' yani vidhayak anant sinh ne pure rajasthan ko hi apne paitrik ganv nadavan men utar diya hai. daraasal, bihar ke bahubli vidhayak anant sinh ki beti ki shadi patna ke barh anumandal sthit nadavan ganv se hone ja rahi hai. 25 navanbar ko shadi ki tarikh hai, iske lie bhavy tarike se taiyariyan chal rahi hain.
